candidates.title: Centre betrayed us, now want full statehood for Ladakh: Sonam Wangchuk
candidates.excerpt: Wangchuk said the representatives of Leh Apex Body (LAB) and Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) had come prepared for Oct 22 talks in Delhi as a follow up of the May 15 meeting in Leh, with the expectation that the MHA and Ladakh bodies' respective drafts on contours and powers of UT-level body and district councils, would be discussed.

candidates.title: PM Modi calls for stronger global institutions; takes ‘failed product’ jab at Cong
candidates.excerpt: Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the need for stronger global institutions during his address at the NDTV World Summit. He argued that the current global system struggles to address new challenges, particularly in international relations. Modi also criticized Congress leadership for failing to effectively launch their leader, calling it a burden on the party. Furthermore, he highlighted India's role in international cooperation, especially during the Covid-19 pandemic.
